title: Tier 2 overdetermination cleanups
description:
Five independent overdetermination findings from the post-c93e545 survey. None contradict the main draft; each one is a place where the spec is more prescriptive than wire interop requires.

Findings:
- Children 2C: ULID mandate for IDs that don't need time-ordering (main draft, 7 sites)
- Child 2D: persistent-outbox mechanism prescription (federation draft)
- Child 2E: receiveTypingIndicators cache TTL hardcoded at 60s (federation draft)
- Child 2F: outbound presence rate limit hardcoded at 30s (federation draft)
- Child 2G: edit-revision push contradicts retention permission (main draft)

These can be done piecemeal; no ordering constraint between them. Each is small (1-7 line edit). Suggested approach: pick them off as time allows rather than batching.
